title: Images That Never Overflow
prompt:
Two declarations make images behave on every screen. Add to `img`: `max-width: 100%` (never wider than its container) and `height: auto` (keep proportions while shrinking).

Rules:
- Both declarations on a plain `img` element selector.

tests.name: images cap at container width
tests.code: if (!/img\s*\{[^}]*max-width\s*:\s*100%\s*;/i.test(code)) throw new Error("Add max-width: 100% to img.");
tests.hint: img { max-width: 100%; } — an image can shrink, never overflow.

tests.name: proportions preserved
tests.code: if (!/img\s*\{[^}]*height\s*:\s*auto\s*;/i.test(code)) throw new Error("Add height: auto to img so images don't squish.");
tests.hint: img { height: auto; } keeps the aspect ratio while the width shrinks.
